changelog:
KeepItDigital 2.0.3 — Release update

- New clean KeepItDigital application shell and navigation.
- Supabase account creation and sign-in.
- Email verification with desktop callback support.
- Gmail SMTP support for authentication emails.
- Modern rounded UI, custom dialogs and improved animations.
- Automatic update checking at application startup.
- New single-executable portable build.
- New Windows installer build.
- Improved release and deployment workflow.
